signedOut: Log in to write to the moderators.

list.title: Moderator mail
list.intro: Messages with the moderation team. Each one goes to the team’s shared inbox, never to one moderator, and a person answers.
list.empty: You haven’t written to the moderators yet.
list.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your messages. Check your connection and try again.
list.subject: Subject
list.noAccount: Without an account? Use the <report>public report form</report> or <contact>Contact us</contact>.

new.title: Write to the moderators
new.intro: Tell us what it is about. Don’t include passwords or someone else’s private details.
new.about: Linked to decision {{reference}}. The team will see which decision it’s about.
new.subject: Subject
new.sent: Sent. Your reference is {{reference}}. We’ll notify you when the team answers.
new.suspendedNote: You can write even while suspended. To appeal a decision formally, use "Appeal this decision" on the reports and decisions page.

thread.note: Internal note by @{{handle}} (only staff see this)
thread.notFound: We couldn’t find this conversation on your account.
thread.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this conversation. Check your connection and try again.
thread.textOnly: Text only. Files can’t be sent here.
thread.reopens: Answering a closed thread opens it again.

failures.too_many: You’ve sent a lot of messages in the last hour. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
failures.not_found: We couldn’t find this conversation or decision on your account.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t send it. Check your connection and try again.

staff.heading: Moderator mail
staff.intro: Messages from members to the moderation team. Answers go out as "The moderation team"; internal notes stay with staff.
staff.loadFailed: We couldn’t load moderator mail. Try again in a moment.
staff.notAllowed: Only moderation staff can read moderator mail.
staff.assignHint: A moderator’s username, or empty for nobody.
staff.replyLabel: Answer as the moderation team, or add a note
